note: Maintained subsystem notes describe bounded development support. Partial never means a whole subsystem is complete. Shared framework rows do not certify every host backend.

areas.name: Java / DEX runtime
areas.notes: Standalone ART, multi-DEX loading and all 4,445 Android API 35 android.* class surfaces compile and smoke-test on OpenJDK and ART. Complete method-level Android behavior remains incremental.

areas.name: Views, input and lifecycle
areas.notes: Layouts, widgets, transitions, property animations, accessibility nodes, IME sessions, pointer input and resizing are exercised; complex custom app flows still expose gaps.

areas.name: Resources and themes
areas.notes: APK resources, binary XML attributes, ICU formatting, density/configuration changes and selected theme paths work; full Material theme parity remains incomplete.

areas.name: Files and preferences
areas.notes: Committed preferences, queued apply writes, PreferenceScreen hierarchies, unified Linux/macOS/Windows OS data paths and DocumentsContract/MediaStore URI models pass OpenJDK/ART tests. Telegram saved-login persistence is still unverified.

areas.name: SQLite storage
areas.notes: Host SQLite, CursorWindow, MergeCursor, CursorJoiner, SQLiteQueryBuilder and SQLiteRawStatement are exercised; every Android SQLite edge case is not established.

areas.name: Networking and TLS
areas.notes: Guest sockets, TLS, DnsResolver, HttpEngine over HttpURLConnection and LinkProperties/IKEv2 models exist; a historical targeted network run records 49 passes while the full suite remains unrun.

areas.name: Binder and Android services
areas.notes: Selected in-process/host IPC services, AccountManager, Telecom CallControl and service SPI classes exist. Full Android system_server behavior and cross-process compatibility are not established.

areas.name: Canvas, EGL and GLES
areas.notes: Real apps render through software/host EGL/GLES paths alongside ColorSpace connectors, ImageDecoder, YuvImage and OpenGL Matrix/ETC1 helpers. Full hardware-accelerated RenderNode parity is not verified.

areas.name: PDF, print and gestures
areas.notes: Pure-Java %PDF-1.4 writer, software PDF rasterizer, text search/selection/annotations, PrintDocumentAdapter pipelines and 2D gesture stroke recognition pass on OpenJDK and ART; host print spooling is not wired.

areas.name: Media containers, EXIF and RenderScript
areas.notes: WAV/ISO-BMFF MediaExtractor and MediaMuxer, TIFF/JPEG ExifInterface read-write, DTMF ToneGenerator, Visualizer DFT and CPU RenderScript intrinsics pass component tests; broad codec coverage remains bounded.

areas.name: AppSearch, Health Connect and AdServices
areas.notes: In-memory AppSearch BM25 indexing, Health Connect typed records/unit conversions and AdServices models pass on OpenJDK and ART; cross-app Android system stores are not emulated.

areas.name: Keystore, Identity, Credentials and NDEF
areas.notes: Host keystore entries, ISO 18013-5 Identity Credential COSE/CBOR sessions, CredentialManager models and NFC Forum NDEF/BLE scan wire codecs work in-process; Secure Element, NFC RF and Bluetooth radios fail explicitly.

areas.name: NDK native C/C++ libraries
areas.verification: Native unit tests and nm audit
areas.notes: All 15 tracked Android API 35 NDK shared libraries (887/887 cataloged C symbols across libandroid, libjnigraphics, libmediandk, libsync, libOpenSLES, libaaudio, liblog, libicu, libamidi, libcamera2ndk, libOpenMAXAL, libbinder_ndk, libneuralnetworks, libvulkan and libnativewindow) build and pass native behavioral tests, including VK_KHR_android_surface ANativeWindow swapchain and AHardwareBuffer memory bridges; Vulkan GPU execution requires a host ICD and physical Camera2 hardware capture remains host-dependent.

areas.name: Android native ELF / Bionic
areas.notes: Telegram library initialization and selected libc, socket, TLS and JNI bridges tested alongside unified 16 KB page-size and ABI policy. This is not complete syscall or native-ABI compatibility.

areas.name: Audio playback, AAC and Opus
areas.notes: AudioToolbox AudioQueue hardware AAudio and PCM output, WAV/AAC/Opus decode (AudioToolbox), AAC encode and timestamps tested with synthetic media and live CoreAudio output. Telegram voice messages and calls remain unverified.

areas.name: VideoToolbox hardware decode
areas.notes: libshiraz-video.so decodes H.264, HEVC, VP9 and AV1 through VideoToolbox alongside AudioToolbox Opus; end-to-end app playback and DRM remain unverified.

areas.name: macOS notifications, location, Metal and gestures
areas.notes: UNUserNotificationCenter notifications, CoreLocation wired into Android LocationManager, ProMotion display refresh pacing, zero-copy IOSurface swapchain & SurfaceTexture (EGL_METAL_TEXTURE_ANGLE + MTLSharedEvent), Security.framework trust anchors, AVFoundation speech voices, App Nap guard, Cocoa live-resize events, Retina 2x/fractional pointer mapping, Cmd-to-Ctrl shortcut policy and trackpad pinch/touch filtering are verified on Apple Silicon; interactive TCC prompts in end-user apps remain under test.

areas.name: Signed macOS .app bundle builder
areas.notes: Builds self-contained signed Shiraz.app bundles with hardened runtime, allow-jit and optional --sandbox App Sandbox entitlements, @rpath library closure and generated .icns icons; notarized release distribution is not yet published.

areas.name: Microphone and camera
areas.notes: Host bridges and foreground consent checks exist; physical capture in Telegram has not been verified. JPEG tests use synthetic pixels.

areas.name: Video recording
areas.notes: The macOS video-recording pipeline is not implemented. Audio-only recording APIs do not imply video support.

areas.name: Android sensors
areas.notes: No Android sensor event bridge is advertised on Darwin.

areas.name: Remote media / casting
areas.notes: Only a local default audio route is provided. Remote and cast routing are unavailable.

areas.name: Windows Win32 host primitives and IPC
areas.notes: CI-verified native Win32 implementations cover CreateFileMappingW shared memory, WaitForMultipleObjects looper, Named Pipe IPC with peer PID lookup, DXGI GPU probe, EnumDisplaySettingsW refresh rate, DXGI shared buffer pool, Win32 sync fences, DwmFlush choreographer pacing, CreateProcessW spawning, SetThreadExecutionState, WM_SIZE/WM_SIZING live resize, portable keyboard table, Precision Touchpad hooks, Job Object + Restricted Token sandbox and HostOs/rundll32 launchers. Full ART and guest ELF execution on Windows is not yet complete.

areas.name: Windows WASAPI, Media Foundation, DirectWrite and services
areas.notes: WASAPI PCM16 audio bridge backing libaaudio.dll and libOpenSLES.dll, Media Foundation H.264/HEVC decoder probing, DirectWrite system font enumeration, GetAdaptersAddresses connectivity, DPAPI keystore, SAPI5 speech probe, Shell_NotifyIconW notifications and Windows Location COM bridges build and pass MinGW-w64 CI tests (make windows-check); interactive end-to-end app media playback on Windows is not yet verified.

areas.name: Windows portable and MSIX bundler
areas.notes: Portable Shiraz\ directory and MSIX AppxManifest.xml bundler with PE32/PE32+ import closure and .ico generation, validated in 3-OS CI; signed Windows installer releases are not yet published.

areas.name: App isolation and sandboxing
areas.notes: Cross-platform SandboxPolicy maps to Linux Landlock LSM + PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS, macOS Seatbelt (sandbox-exec) SBPL profiles + App Sandbox bundle entitlements, and Windows Job Objects + Restricted Tokens; full per-app default enforcement in end-user launchers remains incremental.

areas.name: WebView JavaScript / DOM
areas.notes: Embedded pure-Java HTML5 DOM parser, CSS selector engine, step-budgeted JavaScript evaluator, @JavascriptInterface reflection bridge, postWebMessage, findAllAsync and multi-entry back/forward history pass OpenJDK/ART tests; a full Blink/V8 CSS layout browser engine for rich web editors and modern SPAs is not bundled.

areas.name: Google Play services runtime
areas.notes: Shiraz does not provide the Google Play Store or Google Play system services. Bundled client libraries do not supply those services.

areas.name: Cellular telephony and SMS
areas.notes: E.164 formatting, GSM 7-bit/UCS-2 SMS PDU codecs and CellInfo models work in Java, but Shiraz makes no claim of real modem control, phone calls or carrier SMS.

areas.name: Android platform certification
areas.notes: No complete CTS/VTS run, complete API behavior result or whole-platform compatibility percentage is established.
